items.title: Talent, culture, and ethics are all necessary ingredients in the biotech recipe for success
items.summary: Our CEO, Faraz Ali, spoke with Peter Kaplan for an article in STAT to discuss the core values that are essential for a biotech company’s success. Faraz outlined the ways in which strong ethics and the right moral compass are crucial for creating a culture that empowers all employees.
